message.content:
We have two houses: House 1 (left) and House 2 (right).  
Each person has one of two attributes in each category.

From clue 1: Phone not in house 1 → Phone is in house 2.  
From clue 3: Loafers not in house 1 → Loafers in house 2.  
So house 2 has phone and loafers; house 1 has television and high heels.

Now clue 2: Science fiction fanatic lives somewhere to the left of the tea drinker.  
Since there are only two houses, "left of" means science fiction is in house 1 and tea drinker in house 2.  
Thus house 1: science fiction; house 2: history book buff.  
House 2 also has tea drinker; house 1 has coffee drinker.

The person with the phone lives in house 2.

Final answer: 2
